HISTORICAL_ATLAS.claim: Four underground entrances, five sectors, heavy zombies and card rooms documented in Atlas; not reproduced here as an exact map.
Atlas analytical chains: tiered access, independent power, hazard preparation, boss-to-card-to-distinct-specimen/research. Chains are analysis, not historical named quests.
SOH design scenarios in original Atlas: differentiated boss rewards and parallel non-dungeon progress.

provenance.SOH_PROPOSAL: Every node, credential, action, cost, flood/vent behavior and recovery rule below is new proposed SOH design. No source-authentic timing, balance value or implementation claim.

semantics.conditions: All requires entries are AND. Arrays mean membership; numbers/booleans/strings mean equality. min entries are lower bounds. debit and set apply atomically after all checks pass. Failed actions change nothing.
semantics.edges: Directed movement only; actions occur at their node. Egress conditions never inherit ingress requirements. blocked_edges is an external fault set used by the witness runner.
semantics.units: priming, protection, service_supplies and cargo_free are abstract witness units, not proposed production quantities, seconds or inventory slots. Unit 3 must replace coarse exposure with a bounded safety model.
semantics.credential: Reusable carried authorization, not consumed by doors. maintenance and assay are independent flags. Mechanical registry can replace maintenance without either credential; assay service can reissue without assay.
semantics.power: Exactly none, drainage or ventilation. Every start or mode change spends priming; shutting down is free. No passive resource generation. Switching cannot reset rewards.
semantics.hazard: protection is a coarse remaining safe-work budget. Prepared means protection >= required work plus reserved retreat margin. Egress service channels are assumed dry/shielded and cost zero here; physical proof deferred.
semantics.persistence: Reward receipt flags, service_record, gallery_record and egress_open persist; carried credentials/items can be dropped. Power failure sets power none. Reload preserves committed state; transaction implementation not supplied.
semantics.knowledge: research_lead is information, not recipe ownership. recipe_known remains false throughout these sorties; later A3-approved research consumes the physical specimen under a separate contract.

tradeoff.switching: Two startups in route B exhaust two priming units. Extra mode cycles require additional externally sourced supplies and hazardous trips; never regenerate specimen/residue. No irreversible wing lockout.
tradeoff.boss_alternative: From distributor e14 -> defeat_custodian -> e15/e20/e05 -> start_ventilation -> e16/e17. Saves calibration, service supplies and one startup; combat cost is unresolved, not asserted balanced.
tradeoff.preparation: Dry walk costs travel but no protection; culvert is exposed shortcut. No production distance claim until spatial design. Both reach the same control area without granting assay.
tradeoff.return: Finite loot stays taken; clues/records/latch remain. Return for deferred residue, research specimen recovery or inspection access; no daily refill or infinite stock assumed.
